_readme: Copy ONE provider setup to ~/.config/instapy/llm.json (user-level) or app/llm.local.json (project-level, gitignored). Or skip files entirely and just export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY — the provider is then inferred. Run `node bin/llm-check.js` to verify.

auth.apiKey: sk-ant-... optional inline instead of env

_oauth_google: OAuth without any API key: log in once with `gcloud auth application-default login`, then use mode oauth-adc. The harness refreshes tokens itself via the standard OAuth refresh flow.
_oauth_bearer: Bring-your-own OAuth bearer token (e.g. an Anthropic OAuth access token) from a JSON file containing {"access_token": "..."}:
_local: Local keyless runtimes (Ollama, LM Studio) via the OpenAI-compatible surface:
